justification: Both surfaces are bordered fields with a horizontal band of repeated ornament and small profile figures placed in a lower zone, but that is a generic layout convention. A is dominated by dense rows of pictographic script signs with two seated/kneeling human figures at bottom, while B is dominated by a large central whirling multi-armed disc ringed with bosses and flanked by quadrupeds — no shared specific motif at all.}
